pr_title: Bluetooth: CAP: Commander API and skeleton
pr_body:
Adds the CAP Commendar API and skeleton that can
implemented.

Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41185

issue_context.title: LE Audio: CAP API - Commander
issue_context.body:
Design the API for CAP

See notes from F2F (pending) for agreement on direction for this API
comments:
There are 11 procedures for the CAP commander
API should be similar to the one for the CAP initiator

review_comments: Noted that this is identical to the bt_cap_commander_change_volume_mute_state_param. I think it is good to keep the two definitions since they are used in different procedures

This will effectively be identical to `bt_cap_initiator_unicast_discover`, unless we expand the CAP discovery function to discover the underlying services (e.g. VCS/MICS/BASS for commander and ASCS for Initiator)
